Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the AIIA Child Counsellor - cum- Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the AIIA Child Counsellor - cum- Psychologist post is scheduled for 02-09-2026. Candidates should ensure they report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Child Counsellor - cum- Psychologist position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Psychology from a recognized university. A Post Graduate Diploma in Guidance and Counselling is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are required for this role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 02 years of experience in the relevant field from a recognized institution, organization, or hospital is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Child Counsellor - cum- Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Child Counsellor - cum- Psychologist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this AIIA recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for AIIA Child Counsellor - cum- Psychologist going to be held?
faq.answer: The specific venue details will be available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the notification PDF for the exact location.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the All India Institute of Ayurveda.
